description: Hand-verified capability inventory for Aegis Authenticator (com.beemdevelopment.aegis), version 3.4.2.

features.name: Create and encrypt the vault on first launch
features.description: Create and encrypt the vault on first launch as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: choose to protect the vault with a password

features.name: Unlock the vault with a password
features.description: Unlock the vault with a password as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: type the vault password in the unlock screen

features.name: Unlock the vault with biometrics
features.description: Unlock the vault with biometrics as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: from then on, open the app and present the fingerprint (or face) at the unlock prompt

features.name: Add an entry by scanning a QR code
features.description: Add an entry by scanning a QR code as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: point the camera at the QR code

features.name: Add an entry from a QR code image
features.description: Add an entry from a QR code image as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: tap "Scan an image"/"Scan image from gallery"
select the picture containing the QR code

features.name: Add an entry manually
features.description: Add an entry manually as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: enter the issuer and the account name
choose the type (TOTP, HOTP, Steam, Yandex or mOTP)
set the algorithm, digit count and period or counter

features.name: Edit an entry
features.description: Edit an entry as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: Tap the entry in the list (or long-press it)
change the issuer, name, note, icon, group or token parameters

features.name: Set a custom icon for an entry
features.description: Set a custom icon for an entry as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: choose to select an image from the device or pick one from an installed icon pack

features.name: Import an icon pack
features.description: Import an icon pack as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: confirm; the icons become available in the entry editor

features.name: Copy a code to the clipboard
features.description: Copy a code to the clipboard as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: tap the entry (or its copy icon)
the current code is copied to the clipboard and a confirmation appears

features.name: Reveal a hidden code
features.description: Reveal a hidden code as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: With the "tap to reveal" option enabled
tap the entry in the list
the code is shown for the configured number of seconds before being hidden again

features.name: Generate the next HOTP code
features.description: Generate the next HOTP code as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: tap the refresh/next-code button on that entry; the counter is incremented and the new code is displayed

features.name: Search entries
features.description: Search entries as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: Tap the search icon in the toolbar
type part of the issuer or account name
the list filters as you type

features.name: Sort the entry list
features.description: Sort the entry list as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: choose the order (custom/manual, alphabetical by issuer, alphabetical by account, or last used)

features.name: Reorder entries manually
features.description: Reorder entries manually as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: Set the sort order to custom
drag it to its new position

features.name: Create a group
features.description: Create a group as documented for Aegis Authenticator.

features.name: Assign an entry to a group
features.description: Assign an entry to a group as documented for Aegis Authenticator.

features.name: Filter the list by group
features.description: Filter the list by group as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: Tap the group chip bar at the top of the list (or the filter icon)
tap the "All" chip to clear the filter

features.name: Rename or delete a group
features.description: Rename or delete a group as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: tap Rename and enter the new name, or tap Delete and confirm

features.name: Delete an entry
features.description: Delete an entry as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: tap the delete (bin) icon in the contextual toolbar

features.name: Select and act on multiple entries
features.description: Select and act on multiple entries as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: tap the further entries to add them
use the contextual toolbar to assign a group, delete or share/export them together

features.name: Export the vault as an encrypted file
features.description: Export the vault as an encrypted file as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: the encrypted JSON vault is written

features.name: Export the vault in plain text or as HTML
features.description: Export the vault in plain text or as HTML as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: choose the plain-text JSON or the HTML/QR-code output
read and accept the security warning

features.name: Import a vault from Aegis or another authenticator
features.description: Import a vault from Aegis or another authenticator as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: choose the source application format (for example Aegis, andOTP, FreeOTP, FreeOTP+, Authy, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 2FAS, Bitwarden, Steam, WinAuth or Duo)

features.name: Import entries by scanning a Google Authenticator transfer QR code
features.description: Import entries by scanning a Google Authenticator transfer QR code as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: scan the export QR code produced by Google Authenticator

features.name: Set or change the vault password
features.description: Set or change the vault password as documented for Aegis Authenticator.

features.name: Add a second unlock method (password slot)
features.description: Add a second unlock method (password slot) as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: add a biometric slot or an additional password slot

features.name: Configure automatic locking
features.description: Configure automatic locking as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: tick when the vault should lock (for example when the screen turns off, when the back button is pressed, when the app is minimised, or after a timeout)

features.name: Set the lock timeout
features.description: Set the lock timeout as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: select the period of inactivity after which the vault relocks

features.name: Block screenshots and screen recording
features.description: Block screenshots and screen recording as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: enable the "Secure screen"/screenshot-blocking option; the entry list no longer appears in screenshots or in the recent-apps preview

features.name: Enable a panic trigger
features.description: Enable a panic trigger as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: enable the panic trigger and choose the response (for example lock the vault or wipe it)

features.name: Enable automatic backups to a folder
features.description: Enable automatic backups to a folder as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: set the number of backup versions to keep

features.name: Enable Android system backups
features.description: Enable Android system backups as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: enable the Android built-in backup option
confirm the warning about where the data is stored

features.name: Change the theme
features.description: Change the theme as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: choose light, dark, AMOLED black or "follow system"

features.name: Change the accent colour and dynamic colours
features.description: Change the accent colour and dynamic colours as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: select the colour or enable the Material You dynamic colour option

features.name: Change the entry list view mode
features.description: Change the entry list view mode as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: return; the list density changes accordingly

features.name: Configure code display and copy behaviour
features.description: Configure code display and copy behaviour as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: toggle "Tap to reveal", set the reveal duration, choose whether tapping copies the code, choose whether codes are grouped into digit blocks, and set whether the account name is shown

features.name: Highlight the entry whose code is about to expire
features.description: Highlight the entry whose code is about to expire as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: enable the option that highlights entries or shows the expiry progress

features.name: Change the app language
features.description: Change the app language as documented for Aegis Authenticator.

features.name: View the about screen and licences
features.description: View the about screen and licences as documented for Aegis Authenticator.
actions: read the version number, the source repository link, the licence and the credits
